Someone put another dollar in the juke box, and the theremins started in on Mare Indrium Mary for the tenth time since Pete Ganley had come into the bar. "Aw shut up," he said, wishing there was some way to turn them off. Alice got off work at Houston's at twelve. She ought to be here by now.

arxiv-1708-04445.title: Search for diboson resonances with boson-tagged jets in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1708-04445.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1708-04445.description: Abstract Narrow resonances decaying into W ​ W WW , W ​ Z WZ or Z ​ Z ZZ boson pairs are searched for in 36.7 fb -1 of proton–proton collision data at a centre-of-mass energy of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV recorded with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider in 2015 and 2016.

arxiv-1904-01989.title: Subword-Level Language Identification for Intra-Word Code-Switching
arxiv-1904-01989.creator: Manuel Mager 1 , Özlem Çetinoğlu 1 and Katharina Kann 2
arxiv-1904-01989.description: Abstract Language identification for code-switching (CS), the phenomenon of alternating between two or more languages in conversations, has traditionally been approached under the assumption of a single language per token. However, if at least one language is morphologically rich, a large number of words can be composed of morphemes from more than one language (intra-word CS).

arxiv-2005-04147.title: Quantum Natural Language Processing on Near-Term Quantum Computers
arxiv-2005-04147.creator: K. Meichanetzidis, G. De Felice, A. Toumi and B. Coecke S. Gogioso and N. Chiappori
arxiv-2005-04147.description: Abstract In this work, we describe a full-stack pipeline for natural language processing on near-term quantum computers, aka QNLP. The language-modelling framework we employ is that of compositional distributional semantics (DisCoCat), which extends and complements the compositional structure of pregroup grammars.

arxiv-2102-12700.title: Sentiment Analysis of Persian-English Code-mixed Texts
arxiv-2102-12700.creator: 1 st Nazanin Sabri, 2 nd Ali Edalat, 3 rd Behnam Bahrak
arxiv-2102-12700.description: Abstract The rapid production of data on the internet and the need to understand how users are feeling from a business and research perspective has prompted the creation of numerous automatic monolingual sentiment detection systems. More recently however, due to the unstructured nature of data on social media, we are observing more instances of multilingual and code-mixed texts.

arxiv-2107-08719.title: On the geometric phase and Majorana neutrinos
arxiv-2107-08719.creator: A. Capolupo, S.M. Giampaolo, B. C. Hiesmayr, G. Lambiase, A. Quaranta
arxiv-2107-08719.description: Abstract We analyze the geometric phase for neutrinos and we demonstrate that the geometric invariants associated to transitions between different neutrino flavors, for Majorana neutrinos, can depend on the representation of the mixing matrix and then are sensitive to the nature of neutrinos.

arxiv-2202-04443.title: From a conjecture of Collatz to Thompson’s group ℱ \mathcal{F} , via a conjunction of Girard
arxiv-2202-04443.creator: Peter M. Hines
arxiv-2202-04443.description: Abstract The famous 3 ​ x + 1 3x+1 problem of L. Collatz needs no introduction; however, this paper concerns a lesser-known, but similarly unresolved, precursor problem : the Original Collatz Conjecture, or OCC [ 1 ] . We demonstrate that the core arithmetic operator from the OCC, when combined with a conjunction of J.-Y.

arxiv-2204-13117.title: Dust formation in the outflows of catastrophically evaporating planets 2022 Dust formation in the outflows of catastrophically evaporating planets – C
arxiv-2204-13117.creator: Richard A. Booth, James E. Owen, Matthäus Schulik
arxiv-2204-13117.description: Abstract Ultra-short period planets offer a window into the poorly understood interior composition of exoplanets through material evaporated from their rocky interiors. Among these objects are a class of disintegrating planets, observed when their dusty tails transit in front of their host stars.

arxiv-2307-09336.title: Correlated Short-Timescale Hard-Soft X-ray Variability of the Blazars Mrk 421 and 1ES 1959+650 using AstroSat 2023 Correlated Short-Timescale Hard-Soft X-ray Variability of the Blazars Mrk 421 and 1ES 1959+650 using AstroSat – 6
arxiv-2307-09336.creator: Susmita Das, Ritaban Chatterjee
arxiv-2307-09336.description: Abstract We study simultaneous soft ( 0.7 − 7 0.7-7 keV) and hard ( 7 − 20 7-20 keV) X-ray light curves at a total of eight epochs during 2016 − 2019 2016-2019 of two TeV blazars Mrk 421 and 1ES 1959+650 observed by the SXT and LAXPC instruments onboard AstroSat .

arxiv-2402-18307.title: Multi-Scale Denoising in the Feature Space for Low-Light Instance Segmentation Thanks: This work was supported by the UKRI MyWorld Strength in Places Programme (SIPF00006/1) and EPSRC Doctoral Training Partnerships (EP/W524414/1)
arxiv-2402-18307.creator: Joanne Lin, Nantheera Anantrasirichai, David Bull
arxiv-2402-18307.description: Abstract Instance segmentation for low-light imagery remains largely unexplored due to the challenges imposed by such conditions, for example shot noise due to low photon count, color distortions and reduced contrast. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end solution to address this challenging task. Our proposed method implements weighted non-local blocks (wNLB) in the feature extractor.

arxiv-2406-01312.title: Kinetic Parameters analysis of GdAlO 3 based on thermoluminescent phenomenon
arxiv-2406-01312.creator: D. Nolasco-Altamirano, C.S. Romero-Nuñez, A. Alonso-Sotolongoza, J.F. Benavente, R. García-Salcedo, O.A. García-Garduño, J. Zarate-Medina, V. Correcher, T. Rivera Montalvo
arxiv-2406-01312.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by D. Nolasco-Altamirano, C.S. Romero-Nuñez, A. Alonso-Sotolongoza, J.F. Benavente, R. García-Salcedo, O.A. García-Garduño, J. Zarate-Medina, V. Correcher, T. Rivera Montalvo. We herein report on the calculation of thermoluminescence (TL) kinetic parameters determined from the TL emission of synthetic GdAlO3 (GAO) phosphors prepared by the co-precipitation method.

arxiv-2406-12327.title: Gravastar model in Krori-Barua metric under f ⁡ ( 𝒬 ) f(\mathcal{Q}) gravity
arxiv-2406-12327.creator: Debasmita Mohanty, P.K. Sahoo
arxiv-2406-12327.description: Abstract In this paper, we explore the characteristics of a gravastar in f ⁡ ( 𝒬 ) f(\mathcal{Q}) gravity, which is upheld by Krori-Barua (KB) metric. We have used Krori-Barua (KB) metric for the interior and shell regions of the gravastar. We deduced our field equations by using Krori-Barua metric.

arxiv-2410-01379.title: N. G. Evgenidis et al., ”Hybrid Semantic-Shannon Communications,” in IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications, vol. 23, no. 9, pp. 10926-10940, Sept. 2024, doi: 10.1109/TWC.2024.3376998. This is the authors’ preprint version and not the final published version. The published version is available
arxiv-2410-01379.creator: Nikos G. Evgenidis, Nikos A. Mitsiou, Sotiris A. Tegos, Panagiotis D. Diamantoulakis, Panagiotis Sarigiannidis
arxiv-2410-01379.description: Abstract Semantic communications are considered a promising beyond-Shannon/bit paradigm to reduce network traffic and increase reliability, thus making wireless networks more energy efficient, robust, and sustainable. However, the performance is limited by the efficiency of the semantic transceivers, i.e., the achievable “similarity” between the transmitted and received signals.

arxiv-2503-22966.title: Finite groups with many normalizers
arxiv-2503-22966.creator: Marius Tărnăuceanu
arxiv-2503-22966.description: Abstract A group G G is said to have dense normalizers if each non-empty open interval in its subgroup lattice L ⁡ ( G ) L(G) contains the normalizer of a certain subgroup of G G . In this note, we find all finite groups satisfying this property.

arxiv-2508-04392.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lunji Song †, Juan Diego Toscano §, Li-Lian Wang ‡. arxiv-2509-22784.title: Optical/infrared observations of the extraordinary GRB 250702B: a highly obscured afterglow in a massive galaxy consistent with multiple possible progenitors Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , SWarp ( Bertin 2010 ) , Source Extractor ( Bertin & Arnouts 1996

arxiv-2509-22784.description: Abstract GRB 250702B was the longest gamma-ray burst ever observed, with a duration that challenges standard collapsar models and suggests an exotic progenitor. We collected a rich set of optical and infrared follow-up observations of its rapidly fading afterglow using a suite of telescopes including the W. M. Keck Observatory, the Gemini telescopes, the Magellan Baade Telescope, the Victor M.

arxiv-2601-03113.title: A Probabilistic Digital Twin of UK En Route Airspace for Training and Evaluating AI Agents for Air Traffic Control
arxiv-2601-03113.creator: Nick Pepper, Adam Keane, Amy Hodgkin, Dewi Gould, Edward Henderson, Lynge Lauritsen and Christos Vlahos, George De Ath and Richard Everson, Richard Cannon, Alvaro Sierra Castro , John Korna, Ben Carvell and Marc Thomas
arxiv-2601-03113.description: Abstract This paper presents the first probabilistic Digital Twin of operational en route airspace, developed for the London Area Control Centre. The Digital Twin is intended to support the development and rigorous human-in-the-loop evaluation of AI agents for Air Traffic Control (ATC), providing a virtual representation of real-world airspace that enables safe exploration of higher levels of ATC automation.

arxiv-2604-27969.title: From Mirage to Grounding: Towards Reliable Multimodal Circuit-to-Verilog Code Generation

arxiv-2608-00315.title: Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters
arxiv-2608-00315.creator: Ihab Tabbara, Yuxuan Yang, Hussein Sibai

openalex-w2914300732.title: Application of hydrides in hydrogen storage and compression: Achievements, outlook and perspectives
openalex-w2914300732.creator: José M. Bellosta von Colbe, J.R. Ares, Jussara Barale, Marcello Baricco, Craig E. Buckley, Giovanni Capurso, Noris A. Gallandat, David M. Grant, Matylda N. Guzik, Isaac Jacob, Emil Høj Jensen, Torben Rene Jensen
openalex-w2914300732.source: OpenAlex / International Journal of Hydrogen Energy
openalex-w2914300732.description: Metal hydrides are known as a potential efficient, low-risk option for high-density hydrogen storage since the late 1970s. In this paper, the present status and the future perspectives of the use of metal hydrides for hydrogen storage are discussed. Since the early 1990s,...

pmc-10596762.title: The Solution-focused Intervention for Mental health to promote adolescent mental well-being
pmc-10596762.creator: F Söderqvist, U Norling
pmc-10596762.description: With its compensatory mandate, the school is essential for health-promoting interventions. There are evaluated programs available that prevent mental problems, mental illnesses and various risk behaviours. However, there is a dearth of evaluated interventions designed to promote mental well-being in adolescents, which are adapted for upper secondary school.

pmc-10616284.title: Native American geography shaped historical fire frequency in forests of eighteenth-century Pennsylvania, USA
pmc-10616284.creator: Stephen J Tulowiecki, Brice B Hanberry, Marc D Abrams
pmc-10616284.description: Researchers have debated the relative importance of environmental versus Indigenous effects on past fire regimes in eastern North America. Tree-ring fire-scar records (FSRs) provide local-resolution physical evidence of past fire, but few studies have spatially correlated fire frequency from FSRs with environmental and anthropogenic variables.

pmc-10671834.title: The Unfolded Protein Response in a Murine Model of Alzheimer’s Disease: Looking for Predictors
pmc-10671834.creator: Giulia Sita, Agnese Graziosi, Camilla Corrieri, Luca Ghelli, Sabrina Angelini, Pietro Cortelli, Patrizia Hrelia, Fabiana Morroni, Maria Laura Giuffrida
pmc-10671834.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) represents the most frequent type of dementia worldwide, and aging is the most important risk factor for the sporadic form of the pathology. The endoplasmic reticulum (ER), the main cellular actor involved in proteostasis, appears significantly compromised in AD due to the accumulation of the β-amyloid (Aβ) protein and the phosphorylated Tau protein.

pmc-11495758.title: FAK inhibition delays liver repair after acetaminophen-induced acute liver injury by suppressing hepatocyte proliferation and macrophage recruitment
pmc-11495758.creator: Qing Li, Qi Xu, Jialin Shi, Wei Dong, Junfei Jin, Chong Zhang
pmc-11495758.description: Background:Overdose of acetaminophen (APAP), a commonly used antipyretic analgesic, can lead to severe liver injury and failure. Current treatments are only effective in the early stages of APAP-induced acute liver injury (ALI). Therefore, a detailed examination of the mechanisms involved in liver repair following APAP-induced ALI could provide valuable insights for clinical interventions.

pmc-11596886.title: Optimal Design and Analysis of Wide-Band Near-Infrared Hybrid Dielectric Gratings with High Transmission Efficiency
pmc-11596886.creator: Ye Wang, Yongyi Chen, Li Qin, Lijun Wang
pmc-11596886.description: Since surface relief transmission gratings have very strict requirements on operators and use environment, according to the semiconductor laser external cavity spectral beam combining system, this paper proposes a design scheme for a semiconductor laser array spectral beam combining system based on the grating-external cavity.

pmc-11613804.title: Dynamics of rice seed-borne bacteria from acquisition to seedling colonization
pmc-11613804.creator: Liying Chen, Han Bao, Jie Yang, Yan Huo, Jiabin Zhang, Rongxiang Fang, Lili Zhang
pmc-11613804.description: BackgroundRice cultivation relies on planting grains harboring beneficial microbiota. However, the origination, distribution, and transmission dynamics of grain-borne bacteria remain unclear.ResultsUsing rice grain as a model system, this study investigates the primary sources, major niches in seeds, and the dynamics of community acquisition, maintenance, and transmission between generations of grain-borne bacteria.

pmc-12475841.title: Dietary medium-chain fatty acids mitigate Escherichia coli O78 infection in broilers by enhancing intestinal immune barrier and modulating microbiota
pmc-12475841.creator: Changchun Xu, Qiongge Liu, Mengjie Xu, Habtamu Ayalew, Waqar Iqbal, Jing Lin, Jingyu Song, Linghong Jin, Zhigang Song, Haijun Zhang
pmc-12475841.description: Avian colibacillosis caused by Escherichia coli O78 (E. coli O78) compromises poultry health and performance. Medium-chain fatty acids (MCFAs) exhibit antimicrobial and immunomodulatory properties. This study explored the effects of dietary MCFAs on growth performance, intestinal immune function, and microbiota composition in broilers under E. coli O78 challenge.

pmc-12506444.title: Causal AI-based clinical and radiomic analysis for optimizing patient selection in combined immunotherapy and SABR in early-stage NSCLC: a secondary analysis of the phase II I-SABR trial
pmc-12506444.creator: Maliazurina B Saad, Eman Showkatian, Vivek Verma, Qasem Al-Tashi, Muhammad Aminu, Xinyan Xu, Muhamed Qayati Mohamed, Morteza Salehjahromi, Sheeba J Sujit, Yuliya Kitsel, Steven H Lin, Zhongxing Liao, Saumil Gandhi, David Qian, David Jaffray, Caroline Chung, Natalie I Vokes, Jianjun Zhang, J Jack Lee
pmc-12506444.description: BackgroundThe recent phase II randomized stereotactic ablative radiotherapy with and without immunotherapy (I-SABR) trial has shown improved event-free survival (EFS) when adding immunotherapy to stereotactic ablative radiotherapy (SABR) for early-stage inoperable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, optimizing patient selection thereof is critical, because not every patient benefits from immunotherapy.

pmc-12611508.title: Sugammadex and emergence-related respiratory adverse events in pediatric tonsillectomy: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12611508.creator: Sang-Hwan Ji, Pyoyoon Kang, Jung-bin Park, Young-Eun Jang, Ji-Hyun Lee, Jin-Tae Kim, Hee-Soo Kim, Eun-Hee Kim
pmc-12611508.description: BackgroundThe effects of sugammadex, which reverses neuromuscular blockade, on emergence-related respiratory events in children remain unclear. This study compared the respiratory outcomes of sugammadex and neostigmine in pediatric tonsillectomy.MethodsChildren aged 2 to 6 years undergoing tonsillectomy were randomly assigned to either the sugammadex or neostigmine group.

pmc-12617757.title: Longitudinal tracking of MALAT1 level over a breast cancer patient’s course of treatment and disease progression
pmc-12617757.creator: Disha Aggarwal, Tse-Luen Wee, Shuchismita Satpathy, Suzanne Russo, David L Spector
pmc-12617757.description: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have emerged as important regulators of the hallmarks of cancer, yet their potential remains under-explored in clinical studies. Metastasis-Associated Lung Adenocarcinoma Transcript 1 (MALAT1), an lncRNA upregulated in over 20 tumor types including breast tumors, has been associated with metastasis, yet its expression across the clinical course of treatment and disease progression remains uncharacterized.

pmc-12698943.title: Prevalence of Stroke and Diagnostic Performance of Emergency MRI in Acute Isolated Dizziness
pmc-12698943.creator: Xiao Hu, Sijia Liu, Xiaosan Wu, Sunhong Yan, Jie Shen, Lei Zhu, Xueyun Liu, Zijie Wang, Chu Chen, Tiannan Yang, Chuanqin Fang, Qi Li
pmc-12698943.description: ObjectiveStroke is frequently misdiagnosed in patients presenting with acute isolated dizziness; the optimal imaging modality for this population remains debated. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of stroke among patients with isolated dizziness and to assess the diagnostic accuracy of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT) for stroke detection.

pmc-12805169.title: Impact of Increasing Referral for 99mTc-DPD Scintigraphy on Prognosis Across the Phenotypic Spectrum of Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
pmc-12805169.creator: Chern Hsiang Choy, Chun Shing Kwok, Yasmin Wahid, Boyang Liu, Lauren Turvey-Haigh, Kenneth Parker, James Cullis, Poonam Parekh, Khalid Hussain, Akshanna Akhtar, William M Bradlow, Alex Zaphiriou, Shanat Baig, Julian D Gillmore, Marianna Fontana, Jennifer Pinney, Richard P Steeds, William E Moody
pmc-12805169.description: BackgroundAlthough bone scintigraphy has been widely accepted as integral to the non-biopsy diagnostic algorithm for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM), its prognostic role remains uncertain.ObjectivesThe authors aimed to characterize changes in the referral pattern for 99mTc-DPD scintigraphy and its influence on the clinical phenotype and prognosis of patients diagnosed with ATTR-CM, and among those individuals in whom ATTR-CM is excluded.

pmc-12913929.title: Immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a native omp34 subunit vaccine against Aeromonas hydrophila in BALB/c mice: Identification of nitroblue tetrazolium as a correlate of protection within a One Health framework
pmc-12913929.creator: Rozi Rozi, Wiwiek Tyasningsih, Jola Rahmahani, Eduardus Bimo Aksono Herupradoto, Muchammad Yunus, Mohammad Anam Al Arif, Suryo Kuncorojakti, Annas Salleh, Suwarno Suwarno
pmc-12913929.description: Background and Aim:Aeromonas hydrophila is a zoonotic, antimicrobial-resistant pathogen that causes significant losses in aquaculture and raises important One Health concerns. Outer membrane protein (OMP)–based subunit vaccines provide a targeted, antibiotic-sparing alternative to traditional bacterins, but validation across mammalian species remains limited.

pmc-13157137.title: Reverse cupping–like appearance on CT: A beam hardening–related phenomenon with phantom correlation
pmc-13157137.creator: Rohini Choudhary, Sameer Peer
pmc-13157137.description: The interaction of polychromatic X-ray beam with highly attenuating material leads to beam hardening which may manifest as “cupping” artifact, where the central part of the image appears relatively hypodense as compared to the periphery, a phenomenon arising out of the monochromatic beam assumption of the reconstruction algorithms.

pmc-13381972.title: Impact of electrode drying time on capacitive performance of honey-derived graphene nanosheets for supercapacitors
pmc-13381972.creator: Ahmed Amer Khafaga, Ahmed A. El-Hamalawy, Mohammed Said Mohammed Abu-Elmagd, Sameh Hassan
pmc-13381972.description: Graphene nanosheets have a significant impact in the energy storage field, particularly in the realm of supercapacitors and capacitive deionization, due to their exceptional properties. This research aims to develop a facile method for preparing graphene nanosheets from biomass and examine the influence of the electrode drying time on the electrochemical properties of the prepared electrodes.
